title: Alpha013 price-volume covariance reversal candidate
summary: Alpha013 preserves a reusable daily price-volume microstructure signal: negative ranked covariance between ranked close and ranked volume contains long-side ordering information, but turnover, drawdown, and backend gaps prevent official standalone admission.

mechanism.economic_hypothesis: When volume co-moves too tightly with recent closing-price ranks, part of the move can be forced or inventory-driven rather than informed; the long side pays by short-horizon liquidity demanders and receives by patient liquidity providers who buy after the induced pressure is ranked as exhausted.
mechanism.payer: forced flow, benchmark or inventory-constrained traders, and short-horizon liquidity demand
mechanism.receiver: structured liquidity provider or stat-arb capital that can hold through the repair window
mechanism.target_statistic: next-period long-side expected return and residual rank IC after controlling for turnover cost
mechanism.dirac_style_forced_insight: The covariance operator forces the object to be a joint price-volume state, not a pure reversal score: if volume is removed, the hypothesized payer disappears; if the rank transform is removed, the signal becomes capacity- and scale-dominated.
mechanism.information_preserved_removed: Cross-sectional ranking preserves ordinal pressure and removes absolute liquidity scale; the 5-day covariance preserves short-horizon co-movement but aliases execution cost into turnover unless separately penalized.
mechanism.factor_expression: (-1 * rank(covariance(rank(close), rank(volume), 5))) plus Alpha013 abnormal-volume and persistence revisions as feature candidates.
mechanism.complexity_penalty_reasoning: Persistence and abnormal-volume variants are justified only if they improve after-cost long-side evidence; current evidence confirms ordering but not standalone capital efficiency.

evidence.window: 20160101 through available IS evidence in Alpha013 library records
evidence.portfolio_policy: long-side top group / diagnostic deciles, not direct short-leg promotion
evidence.cost_assumption: self_quant cost diagnostics available; after-cost long-side is negative in canonical record
evidence.falsification: Reject standalone promotion unless OOS and after-cost long-side evidence survive turnover reduction without deleting the covariance payer.

variant_family_coverage.scope: ALPHA013 historical ordinary/knowledge/iteration records are mapped to this mechanism-family node; individual variants still require their own artifact review before promotion.

relations.note: The factor is a ranked covariance projection of price and volume states.
The long-side interpretation is pressure exhaustion and repair rather than continuation.
The evidence is most useful as an ordinal stat-arb feature, not a standalone strategy.
Gross ranking survives, but canonical after-cost long-side evidence is negative.
Reuse as a model feature or conditioner when a new idea depends on forced price-volume pressure.

reuse_guidance: Retrieve this node for new price-volume covariance, abnormal-volume, liquidity-pressure, or Alpha101-style rank/covariance ideas.
Do not treat positive Rank IC as sufficient; check whether turnover cost consumes the long-side edge.
If revising, preserve the joint price-volume covariance object; pure price reversal is a different hypothesis.
Use the node as a feature-candidate analogy for ML combination or risk-conditioned long-only variants.
